subject.title: Sub-agent startup silence: no first-progress signal, aborted runs appear as hangs

question: Should OpenClaw add new core sub-agent lifecycle phases for first progress and typed startup failure, or solve startup silence through narrower diagnostics and terminal-outcome projection?
rationale: Source inspection supports the observability gap, but the requested fix creates a new core event surface consumed by gateway, session, SDK, and subagent paths, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape on its own.

options.title: Adopt lifecycle phases
options.body: Accept `first-progress` and typed `startup-failed` as the contract and request a fresh current-main implementation with consumer coverage and proof.

options.title: Use existing projections
options.body: Keep lifecycle phases unchanged and require a smaller fix that surfaces startup aborts through terminal outcome, diagnostics, or task/session status.

options.title: Wait for replay fixtures
options.body: Defer implementation until the live corpus or representative fixture can be replayed against current main.

recommendation.title: Adopt lifecycle phases
recommendation.body: Accept `first-progress` and typed `startup-failed` as the contract and request a fresh current-main implementation with consumer coverage and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent terminal outcome and gateway/session projection work is closest to the cross-surface API choice this issue requires.
